resources.string: Update your AniList progress as you finish anime episodes.
Finishing an anime episode moves its AniList entry forward. To bring your AniList history into Fetch, use Import from another source.
Sign in from your phone: Settings → Configure from phone, scan the code, then open Accounts → AniList.
Sign in to AniList and approve Fetch. AniList then shows a long token: copy it, come back here and paste it below.
AniList didn’t accept that token. Sign in again and copy the whole token.
